title: Surreal Living Room Portal
description: A woman in a blue dress kneels on a black and white checkered floor, reaching toward a large red circular portal containing a yellow rubber duck with an angry expression. In the background, a gnarled tree extends into a surreal night sky where a black furry monster with glowing eyes, a silver robot, and a purple ghost float among clouds and a broken ceiling.
